title: Nolita Medium Nubuck Shoulder Bag
description_html:
Nolita Medium Nubuck Shoulder Bag by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 15.75”W X 9.75”H X 5”D
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance.
  • Hardware: Gold-tone hardware
  • Lining: 37% rayon/24% polyester/24% cotton/15% linen
  • Closure: Zip fastening
